title: Contact Harbourview Plumbing & Drain | Book a Plumber
description: Call (250) 555-0142 or send a request online to book a licensed plumber in Port Alder, Cedar Falls or Millbrook. Emergency line answered 24/7.
lead: Call for anything urgent. For everything else, send the form and we'll call back within the hour during business hours.

sections.heading: Before you call about a leak
sections.html: If water is actively running, close your main shut-off valve first. In most Port Alder homes it's where the water line enters the basement or crawlspace; in valley homes on wells, turn off the breaker for the well pump. Then call, and we'll talk you through the rest.
